## Index

[Chapter-01-Introduction](chapters/01-introduction.qmd) provides an overview of the book's purpose and structure.

[Chapter-02-Models](chapters/02-models.qmd) covers the fundamental models in AI.

[Chapter-03-Running-a-Model](chapters/03-running-a-model.qmd) explains how to run and use these models.

[Chapter-04-Agents-and-Harnesses](chapters/04-agents-and-harnesses.qmd) discusses the role of agents and harnesses in AI.

[Chapter-05-Building-a-Working-Stack](chapters/05-building-a-working-stack.qmd) guides you through building a functional AI stack.

[Chapter-06-Miscellaneous-Tools](chapters/06-miscellaneous-tools.qmd) lists various tools that are useful in AI development.

[Chapter-07-Resources](chapters/07-resources.qmd) provides a collection of resources for further learning.

[Chapter-08-Keeping-the-Map-Alive](chapters/08-keeping-the-map-alive.qmd) offers tips for maintaining and updating your AI knowledge base.

[Appendix-Glossary](appendices/Glossary.qmd) contains definitions of key terms used throughout the book.

[Appendix-Notes](appendices/Notes.qmd) includes additional notes and references for deeper understanding.
